## Checklist

- [ ] I edited only files under `bib/` (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`,
      `exports/`, and `figures/` are generated — a maintainer regenerates them).
- [ ] Each new entry has `survey_kind`, and, for a `method`, `survey_route`,
      `survey_application`, and `survey_robot`
      (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the allowed values).
- [ ] `survey_family` matches the file the entry lives in.
- [ ] The entry has a `doi`, `url`, or `eprint`.
- [ ] The paper is not already in the catalog.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes (optional — CI runs it for you).
